modules.title: Keyword Research
modules.content:
# Keyword Research

Keyword research is the process of identifying the search terms that people are using to find information related to your product or service. It is a crucial step in optimizing your Amazon listings for higher rankings.

## Benefits of Keyword Research

*   Improved search visibility
*   Increased traffic to your listings
*   Higher conversion rates
*   Better understanding of customer needs
